gloss: foot of a mountain; base; breadth

definitions.explanation: The broad, gently sloping area at the base of a mountain or volcano.
Used figuratively to describe the broad base or wide reach of something, such as the range of people involved in an industry or the spread of a trend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裾野|すその}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧。
examples.english: The foothills of Mount Fuji are vast.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裾野|すその}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a small village at the foot of the mountain.

examples.japanese: {裾野|すその}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧⟦{草原|そうげん}→草原：05035_sougen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{牛|うし}→牛：01857_ushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{放牧|ほうぼく}→放牧：20606_houboku⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Cattle were grazing on the grasslands that spread across the foothills.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裾野|すその}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧。
examples.english: This industry has a broad base.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裾野|すその}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The reach of the gaming industry is expanding.

examples.japanese: {裾野|すその}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{関|かか}わっている→関わる：03020_kakawaru⟧。
examples.english: In a technology field with a wide base, many companies are involved.

notes:
KANJI: ⟦{裾|すそ}→裾：06488_suso⟧ means hem/skirt/bottom edge; ⟦{野|の}→野：03535_no⟧ means field/plain. Together they describe the "hem" or bottom edge of a mountain spreading out like fabric.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裾野|すその}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧: to have a broad base (literal and figurative)
- {裾野|すその}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to broaden the base/reach
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裾野|すその}: the foot of the mountain

NOTE: Also the name of a city ({裾野|すその}{市|し}) in Shizuoka Prefecture, located at the foot of Mount Fuji.
